title: Camps roster: cards when the table has too little room (L-02)
subtitle: The rule is already approved (v1.053, v1.130; Jeffrey 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06): a roster picks its layout from the room beside the left panel, not from the window's width. Real preview screens of April Vacation Camp, a 5-day camp. Today the table keeps its columns whatever the room, so in a narrow room it is wider than its box and Friday and the ⋯ column can only be reached by scrolling sideways. After, when the room is too narrow for this week's columns, the roster draws its cards (the phone layout); a mouse also gets a ⋯ on each card. Amber = what differs.

sections.heading: 1 · A mouse in a half-width laptop window (683 px wide, Standard panel)

items.caption: The table is 673 px wide in a 561 px box. Friday and the ⋯ column are cut off; the person scrolls sideways to reach them.

columns.label: After

row.caption: Cards, with a ⋯ on each (mouse). All five days fit. The buttons keep their mouse size (36 px day boxes) because there is no touch.
The card's ⋯ is the roster row's ⋯: the same items, in the same order.

columns.note: Only the roster changes. The page around it, its dialogs and its ⋯ menus keep following the window.

sections.heading: 2 · An iPad held upright with the Largest panel (768 px wide, touch)

items.caption: 633 px of table in a 622 px box: Friday runs off the edge (“Fri”, “Late” cut).
Cards, no ⋯ (touch): the name opens Camper detail, whose More holds the same items, as on a phone. 44 px targets, as today's cards.

sections.heading: 3 · Where nothing changes (enough room: the table stays)

items.caption: Same as today: 748 px of room; the 5-day table needs 683.
Same as today. Phones (390, 320) are cards today and stay as they are.

footer: How it decides. The table needs room for the page margins (50 px), the Camper and Paid columns, each day of the week on screen (about 89 px each) and, with a mouse, the ⋯ column (40 px). Measured on the built table. Room needed, by days in the shown week — 1 day 327 touch / 367 mouse · 2 416 / 456 · 3 505 / 545 · 4 594 / 634 · 5 683 / 723 · 6 772 / 812 · 7 861 / 901. The room is the window minus the left panel (72 px, 96 with Largest) and, on a PC, the scrollbar. So a 5-day camp with a mouse and the Standard panel switches to cards in windows under about 810 px; on a touch screen under about 755 px (about 779 with Largest). Also: the card layout has no legend under it (as phones today). Mouse sizes on cards are new: 32 px name link, 36 px day boxes, ⋯ as on the table; on touch they stay 44 px. No database change.
